newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics launches combination modems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics launches combination modems.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Monday it introduced two new modems which allow for digital and analog connections from the same device.

The modems, the NETServer/8 I-modem and NETServer/16 I-modem, are targeted at small and medium-sized companies which allow employees to "telecommute" or work from home or off base, or for Internet service providers.
U.S. Robotics said that previously users had to piece together as many as four different types of equipment to get the same result.
The NETServer/8 has a list price of $8,995 and the NETServer/16 $13,995. Both products are expected to begin shipping late this month.
